Title: KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, FLA. -   Japanese astronaut Koichi Wakata (left) releases a tray  extended from inside the Pressurized Module, or PM, that he was working with.  Part of the Japanese Experiment Module (JEM), the PM provides a shirt-sleeve environment in which astronauts on the International Space Station can conduct microgravity experiments. There are a total of 23 racks, including 10 experiment racks, inside the PM providing a power supply, communications, air conditioning, hardware cooling, water control and experiment support functions.  The JEM/PM is in the Space Station Processing Facility.
